label: Sunday free agency in the app: from the Sunday 9:00 AM ET waiver run until the Monday 9:00 PM ET re-lock, free agents show Add now (immediate, first come first served), matching MFL's own league calendar. A player locks when his game kicks off (shown as "Locked · game started"); outside the window players show Bid. After the season's last Monday the app shows no add/drops, as MFL does.
